signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: Your appointments, records and workspace in one place.
signIn.phoneNotVerified: Your mobile number isn't verified yet.
signIn.phoneNotVerifiedUseEmail: Sign in with your mobile number to get a verification code.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.intro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfa.recoveryHint: One of the 8 codes you saved when you set up two-step sign-in. Each works once.
mfa.lost: Lost your phone? Ask your clinic administrator to reset your two-step sign-in.

mfaSetup.title: Set up two-step sign-in
mfaSetup.intro: Staff accounts can open patient records, so signing in needs a code from your phone as well as your password.
mfaSetup.step1Body: Any app that makes time-based codes works, such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator.
mfaSetup.step2Body: In the app, add an account and point your camera at the code.
mfaSetup.qrAlt: QR code to add ClinicFlow to your authenticator app
mfaSetup.manualKey: Can't scan it? Enter this key:
mfaSetup.step3Title: Enter the 6-digit code from the app
mfaSetup.recoveryWarning: Save these 8 codes somewhere safe, such as a password manager. If you lose your phone, each code signs you in once.
mfaSetup.savedRequired: Confirm that you've saved your recovery codes.

invitation.title: {{inviter}} invited you to join ClinicFlow
invitation.fullNameHint: As patients and colleagues will see it.
invitation.emailHint: Set by the invitation. You'll sign in with it.
invitation.agree: I agree to the staff security policy and the patient data protection rules.
invitation.submit: Join and set up two-step sign-in
invitation.wrongDetails: Invited with the wrong email or role? Ask the person who invited you to send a new invitation.
invitation.unusableHint: Ask the person who invited you to send a new one.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.intro: Book visits, get reminders, and see your prescriptions and receipts.
signUp.phoneHint: We'll text you a 6-digit code to verify it.
signUp.emailHint: Add it to get reminders and receipts by email too.
signUp.agree: I agree to the terms of use and the privacy notice.

verify.title: Verify your phone
verify.expired: This code has expired. Ask for a new one.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Choose how to get your reset code or link.
forgot.privacy: We never say whether an account exists.
forgot.emailSentBody: If an account uses <email>{{email}}</email>, we've sent it a link to choose a new password. The link works for 24 hours.
forgot.demoLink: Demo: open the link from the email
forgot.demoNoEmail: Demo: no email was sent, because no confirmed account uses this address.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.intro: Choose a strong password for your account.
reset.signOutNote: You'll be signed out on every device once your new password is saved.
reset.doneBody: Sign in with your new password.
reset.incompleteLink: This link is incomplete or has already been used.

locked.title: Too many attempts
locked.intro: For your security, please wait before trying again. Your account stays protected.
locked.contactTitle: Need help now? Contact a branch

confirmEmail.doneBody: You can now use it to sign in and to get notifications.

email.addHint: We'll send messages about your account and visits here.
email.linkSent: We sent a confirmation link to <email>{{email}}</email>. Open it, then come back here.
